frozenComponentsBoundary: This index is bound to the supplied workflow/driver/browser blobs. Wrapper and guide were read at fixed candidate 84ce7f876817f0d73c34a1ef89797fc27ba8661e. At actual activation, bind the real main/served revision and verify the deployed source contains the reviewed components; this is not a claim that the candidate has merged or deployed.

existingOps.activation: An owner-authorized normal commit on this owned branch, changing a watched path and using the selected commit-message prefix. No activation occurred in this review.

dispatch.sourceGuards: GET main ref must equal expected-deployment-sha, and GET fixed production /mikka/api/version build must equal it; then POST run-trace-acceptance.yml dispatches with ref main.
dispatch.outcome: HTTP 204 plus closed stdout dispatched/requestId/mode/modelCase/revision. This does not prove a downstream run completed or return its run ID.
dispatch.downstreamBinding: Identify the actual run by workflow path, workflow_dispatch event, expected head SHA and creation window; keep ops run ID distinct from acceptance run ID and application workflowRunIds.

shutdown.activationRequirement: The cleanup commit must change a watched path; a message-only/empty commit does not satisfy this workflow's paths filter.
shutdown.boundary: Deleting the refs prevents new branch-triggered work but is not cancellation or proof of cleanup for an already queued/running job.
shutdown.sequencing: After all owned acceptance/export operations and artifact preservation finish, and required source objects are reachable from a durable commit, Root can use this existing owned cleanup path once. Record actual cleanup job outcome and exact ref absence; do not treat a planned cleanup as completed.

minimalSequence.name: Read-only business preflight
minimalSequence.purpose: Normal own sign-in/session workspace selection, deployment check, both exact models, subscription/cloud availability, idle state and live readiness. No model task or browser.
minimalSequence.sideEffects: Creates/closes its own authentication session; existing model-order discovery can persist a missing catalogue without inference. This is not a claim of zero application writes.
minimalSequence.expectedOutcome: report.status=ready with both cases ready, or a closed blocked reason. Prepare-required blockers must be understood rather than bypassed.

minimalSequence.name: One real Claude browser case
minimalSequence.expectedAction: Runner independently signs in and clicks New task / Coordinator / Mikka Cloud / exact temporary Profile once; no manual duplicate click.
minimalSequence.nextBoundary: Retain original report/recovery/browser receipt and confirm owned cleanup and settings restoration before the next model.

minimalSequence.name: One real Codex browser case
minimalSequence.expectedAction: Same ordinary browser path for this case; one click, no submission retry.
minimalSequence.nextBoundary: Retain independent exact-case evidence and complete cleanup; this case does not inherit the previous case's success.

minimalSequence.name: Existing PostHog verification and native exports
minimalSequence.action: Use the already frozen 14 queries/normalizer/reconciler unchanged, with real retained IDs and time windows. Only after actual evidence readback use export mode with a real positive numeric dashboard or insight ID; optional session-id/trace-id must both be real and belong together.

minimalSequence.name: Preserve evidence and close owned ops
minimalSequence.action: One original reader verifies immutable run/attempt/head, artifacts and their digests, writes the evidence index; only then use the existing two-ref cleanup mechanism when Root no longer needs the transport.

workflowContract.credentials: Existing ACME account from existing prod:/ identity, loaded only after source guards and offline tests. No new account or identity.
workflowContract.workspaceGuard: Unique owned admin personal workspace and own subscription/runtime are driver implementation guards; ACME itself is the issue-specified account. This does not reinterpret the issue as a new authorization restriction.
workflowContract.prepareMeaning: Only execute may enable prepare. It temporarily disables enabled Profiles/API-key fallback through normal APIs and restores acknowledged versions/values in finally; it is not an exemption from the case gates.
workflowContract.submissionBudget: One UI submission per deployment/model, zero paid resubmissions. Factory v2 permits one execute and one independent review native run; historical flow permits verify too. Coordinator/model requests within that workflow are not claimed to be exactly one inference.
workflowContract.rerunBoundary: Deterministic fixture Profile blocks repeated execution for the same deployment/model. Do not automatically rerun a blocked, failed, timed-out or uncertain-click case.
workflowContract.readinessComment: Wrapper posts one checked fixed-fixture progress comment to #1512 before the actor starts. Runner mode explicitly says not to submit manually.

acceptance.name: run-trace-acceptance-${github.run_id}
acceptance.zipMemberBoundary: These are configured file paths and expected basenames under their common upload root. The unique artifact reader must verify the actual ZIP member list before extraction.
acceptance.earlyFailure: Artifact upload is always() with if-no-files-found=warn. A failure before the driver or a killed process may omit files; a successful upload step alone does not prove a complete report.

export.name: run-trace-posthog-${github.run_id}
export.inputs: mode=export; actual expected-deployment-sha; export-target dashboard|insight; positive numeric export-id. Optional real session-id and matching nonzero 32hex trace-id are supplied together.
export.boundary: A native PNG/export receipt and one segment readback do not by themselves replace actual Replay playback or the full trace/AI/Logs evaluation.

controlledFailure.name: run-trace-controlled-failure-${github.run_id}
controlledFailure.reason: Existing immutable controlled-failure/overhead applicability review is retained. This preparation does not require or perform another probe.

deploymentAndSource.meaning: Expected 40hex main build; /api/version build equality checked before and throughout the case, and at end.

deploymentAndSource.path: startedAt / finishedAt / mode / modelCase / status / code
deploymentAndSource.meaning: Case invocation and closed outcome; not an infrastructure release receipt.
Actor exact workflow source and production version checks.
Actual ordinary browser business-origin checks; the shell build alone does not prove the selected backend.

applicationIds.meaning: Closed opaque ownership scope for recovery; no email or credentials.
Exact model case and temporary Profile identity.
Actual Factory task and issue observed through normal owner APIs.
Actual native runs; the driver uses these IDs in the normal thread/machine routes. There is no separate serialized threadId field; do not fabricate one for PostHog.
Observed application wrun_* Coordinator workflow identifiers, not GitHub workflow run IDs.
Exact persisted actual browser human message matched after baseline; no raw message retained.

traceAndReplay.meaning: Actual browser PostHog Replay session UUID, not its login cookie/session token.
Before-click readiness; uploadAcknowledged remains unknown until independent backend evidence.
Only API submission mode creates a client-parent trace receipt. Browser mode does not create this field or invent a traceparent.

traceAndReplay.path: actual trace ID via retained task/run/workflow IDs and browser session
traceAndReplay.meaning: Real browser trace must be discovered/read back through the existing frozen queries. No driver/browser receipt directly proves its full parent tree.
Remain false; runtime_verified is not PostHog verification.

runtimeAndResult.meaning: Normal evidence checked exact subscription route, requester/owner/workspace and owned E2B runtime.
Distinct required native checks for the current candidate/request epoch.
Downloaded exact fixed artifact bytes, without content in the report.
Normal Owner acceptance and passed no-repository deliverable approval receipt.

runtimeAndResult.path: workerFingerprint W / templateId / templateBuildId / sandboxId / Vercel deploymentId
runtimeAndResult.meaning: No direct field. Preserve the already accepted release-config mapping plus successful startup/registration and run-identity inference; do not invent fields or impose AppSHA==runtimeSHA.

cleanup.meaning: All required booleans must support complete; evidence is retained.
ended requires normal end API HTTP200 with exact runId/state; not_created requires specified404 plus owned terminal run and explicit null machine. This is not a provider-ID404 receipt.
Only fields reached by execution appear; absence is not automatic success.
Driver normal sign-out and recovery-write status.
Actor stops pending UI, signs out using its own context, verifies anonymous state and closes resources. Wrapper waits and fails if browser cleanup fails.

cleanup.path: revision / scope / sequence / checkpointFailures / preparation / cases
cleanup.meaning: Atomic 0600 write-ahead metadata snapshots; intent/acknowledged/rejected/restored and temporary binding+revision receipts. Full private Profile definitions are not persisted; no automatic replay or permission to guess a lost write.

closingRules: Let the owned driver and actor run their normal finally paths; a force kill/job timeout does not prove restoration.
Any cleanup-incomplete state halts later model cases. Do not automatically repeat a paid submission.
Preserve accepted task/thread/artifact evidence; archive only the owned temporary Profile and end only the exact owned case machines.
Do not conflate Git transport cleanup, application cleanup, browser cleanup and provider resource evidence.

existingPostHogComponents.preservedContract: Actual IDs/time window, six paged queries of 500 with genuine empty last page after exact-full pages, two stable complete snapshots, unmodified raw MCP results. Reconciler overallAcceptance remains null and final actual judgment remains separate.

originalReaderPlan.proposed: Root is the single original reader for each acceptance/export run and its artifact; other reviewers consume immutable Git evidence projections.
originalReaderPlan.assignmentBeforeRead: Record workflow run/attempt, job IDs, actual source SHA, input manifest/requestId, artifact ID/digest/size and original-reader owner.
originalReaderPlan.collection: Read each original log/ZIP only once after terminal status as necessary, preserve original safe JSON bytes, verify ZIP digest/members and report source bindings, then archive a path/size/SHA256/Gitblob manifest.
originalReaderPlan.rawLogBoundary: Use only safe reports/closed error metadata in chat; never echo account credentials, cookies, upstream free-form errors or account content.

concreteUnknownsBeforeActivation: Actual approved source/account window and the final main/served revision M; not queried or reserved here.
Actual preflight outcome and therefore whether prepare is needed.
Actual downstream workflow run IDs and artifact IDs, allocated only after authorized dispatch.
Actual task/run/workflow/Replay IDs, full browser trace and PostHog ingestion/playback evidence; formal cases remain 0/2.
Direct per-run W/template/sandbox fields are absent from the frozen report schema; retain the previously approved evidence-inference boundary.

operations.evidenceOnly: One unreferenced proof blob with exact readback.
